name: The Box
source:
A simple story that goes like this: You live in a box. You have never left this box. You wish you could. Depending on your choices, maybe you finally will.

[from [url=https://rulerlessworld.itch.io/the-box]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个简单的故事是这样的：你住在一个盒子里。你从未离开过这个盒子。你希望你可以。根据你的选择，也许你最终会这样做。

[来自[url=https://rulerlessworld.itch.io/the-box]itch.io[/url]]
